conbody.p: The sensor entity is a critical input for the ADI OtoSense™ SMS system. Sensors have the following characteristics:

ul.li: Sensors measure real-world phenomena and send these readings to the ADI OtoSense™ SMS platform for analysis.
Sensors are attached to motors and monitor the motor for anomalies, including fault detection.
Sensors must be provisioned before they can monitor a motor and send data to the ADI OtoSense™ SMS service.
